excerpt: Namely is HR, payroll and benefits software with managed services for mid-sized US companies, part of Vensure Employer Solutions since 2022. From $9 per employee per month.
content:
Namely is a US human capital management (HCM) platform for small and mid-sized companies. Its core software covers HR records, onboarding, reporting, payroll, time and attendance and a mobile app, with add-on modules for benefits administration, applicant tracking with AI-assisted recruiting, performance management and compliance. Alongside the software it sells managed services: managed HR with dedicated consultants and handbook support, managed payroll that handles day-to-day processing, and managed benefits with brokerage services. Some packages also include large-group health benefits, workers' compensation plans and shared compliance liability, the kind of offering usually associated with a professional employer organisation (PEO).

Merger with Vensure and PrismHR

On 6 September 2022 Namely announced that it had merged with the organisation formed by combining Vensure Employer Services, one of the largest PEOs in the US, and PrismHR, which provides software to HR service providers. In the announcement, Vensure's CEO Alex Campos said the combined company had about 3,600 employees and served more than three million worksite employees. Namely's website now describes it as a Vensure Employer Solutions company. Terms were not disclosed.

Pricing

Namely lists four packages: NamelyNow, NamelyPlus, NamelyPlus People and NamelyComplete. Its pricing page says NamelyNow starts at $9 per employee per month; for the other packages and services, Namely quotes based on the modules, services and complexity required.

Who it suits

Namely suits US companies, roughly from growing startups to mid-sized firms, that want HR software and the option to hand payroll, benefits and HR administration to a managed service. Very large enterprises with complex global payroll needs may look at bigger HCM suites.

We have not tested Namely. This page is based on Namely's website and pricing page (checked 15 October 2026) and its September 2022 merger announcement.
